item.description: [ɫɤ:ɾɑ̃ṉ] Notes: clawbar.
[ɫɑ̃:ɑɡ] Notes: axe.
[lʹipɔx] Notes: having a lisp.
[ɫoxt̪] Quotation: lobht an fheòir. Notes: hay loft.
[ɫɔ:nʹɑɡ] Notes: snowflake.
Notes: a mock calf.
[mɛ̃ṉɑxɾəv] Notes: small stock. Used of cattle or sheep.
Notes: first sounds made by a young animal.
[m[ũ̜ĩ]lʹɛ̃ṉ] Notes: bundle of hay or fodder rolled against the chest with the arms. Becomes barrel-shaped.
Quotation: sia-raitheach mult, da-bhliadhnach mult.
[rɔʃɡʹɛ̃ṉ] Quotation: roisgean fhliuch. Notes: wet or muddy hem of a garment.
[rɔ̃:ɑṉ] Quotation: Leig e ròmhan as. Notes: “ròmhanaich” used of the roaring of a bull. Above used of a man.
[rɔ̃:ɑ̃ṉiç] Notes: the roaring of stags.
[ru̜ɤi] Quotation: a’ ruaidh. Notes: chill in the udder of cows causing inflammation. The milk doesn’t flow so freely.
[poɫɑɡ] Notes: potato pit.
Notes: a small haycock. See prabag-tuill.
[pɾɑbɑɡt̪[ɤi]lʹ] Notes: bundle of hay rolled round the arms like a muff. Arms pulled out leaving a hole through it. Laid on the ground.
Notes: pl. seotaichean. Second-class animal. Also used for second-class seed.
Notes: lameness in horses due to physical strain.
[spɫɔxkɑṉ] Notes: advanced form of liver fluke.
[st̪u̜:ʴstʹəṉ] Notes: water on the brain in sheep. [NOTES: the turned r used for the symbol which is unclear in the original.]
[t̪ɤɣɑ̃ṉ] Notes: pole-cat.
[tʹɛ̃ṉe:lʹtʹ] Notes: electrical flashes in the sky on a clear night.
[t̪ɔɾɔʃɡʹĩɑ̃ṉ] Notes: peat-cutting iron.
Notes: an old maiden ewe, getting on for three years old.
[beɫm[ũĩ]çc] Notes: “sow-mouthed” in animals. Also “bus-muic”.
Notes: badger hunter or vermin hunter in general.
Notes: the striker of the flail.
[bu̟:ɾɑṉiç] Notes: the bellowing of a bull.
Notes: “sow-mouthed” in pigs. Also “beul-muic”.
Quotation: a’ cur a mhoine air cas-bheag. Notes: one peat lying with another two peats having one end on the ground and the other resting on the flat peat.
Notes: haycock.
Quotation: dais móine. Notes: fairly large collection of peats lifted into the one structure to dry. Verb – a’ daiseadh.
Notes: rubbish.
[fliçṉiç] Notes: sleet.
Notes: small potato.
[ɡʹɛ̃ṉɑɾɑɡ] Notes: stone hammer.
[ɡʹ[ɛ̃ĩ]lɑɡ] Notes: crow-bar.
[ɡe:məɾıç] Notes: the lowing of a cow.
Notes: the dipper. (Or lòn-dubh-an-éisg, according to D. Robertson, Invergarry.)
[ɡɾɑ̃nʹɑx] Notes: crabbit. Lewis: [ɡrɑ̃n̪ɑx].
[ɡɾɔ:ɡʹ] Notes: a ham-handed person. Adj. gròigeach.
[ɡɾɔ:ɡʹɑx] Notes: ham-handed.
